Each forge buys a per-cast emission license before lighting one heat. The license names a single casting cycle; the next heat needs the next license, and licenses are not transferable between furnaces.

Enforcement: after each cast, inspectors match the smoke plume against an atlas of licensed heats; a plume with no license voids that cast on the registry.

Attack cost: a sybil wanting n heats buys n licenses at full price - no bulk rate, none shared across forges. Cost rises linearly per fake identity; a real forge pays once per cast.
